state_definitions.external_discussed: A third-party community or maintainer substantively discussed the artifact at a permanent public URL.
state_definitions.external_referenced: A third-party project document, issue, or specification references the artifact.
state_definitions.external_implemented: A non-BioNexus party produces or consumes the artifact with reproducible evidence.
state_definitions.external_adopted: A third-party project formally includes the artifact in supported practice or a normative specification.

claim_boundary: Only attributable third-party public evidence may create a record. Maintainer drafts, self-tests, private conversation summaries, screenshots, and repository mentions do not count.
